Hello Dawei,

I hope this message finds you well. I'm excited to invite you to a tech panel discussion I'm hosting next Tuesday, December 10, at the Tech Hub Conference Center here in Orchard County. Please find the event details attached. Let me know if you can make it!

Best regards,
Jeff Bing
